lines: The Indiana Fever edged the Phoenix Mercury 92-89 yesterday and improve to 13-9.
The Indianapolis Indians beat the Toledo Mud Hens 6-5 yesterday, moving to 40-50 on the season.
The Fever head to Las Vegas on Sunday at 9:00 PM ET to take on the Aces.
The Indians host the Mud Hens again tonight at 7:05 PM ET.
